boundary: A bounded socketless poll-owner composes the adopted Authority owner and worker lanes over the single TunerService Engine. Control and data pools each have 32 entries. START, typed ATTACH prepare/commit, packet reads, typed STREAM_END, STOP cleanup, and paired ingress shutdown use the Authority high-ID stream ticket. The existing Windows runtime security helper is included for the worker's runtime parent and DACL checks. Wire STOP dispatch and OS listeners remain outside this increment; no product dispatch or device integration is included.
